# Missouri EPIC Flag Football

> Missouri EPIC is Southwest Missouri's premier youth flag football organization, based at Ballparks of America in Branson, MO. Woman-owned, founded 2018 by Terri Crisler. Offers NFL FLAG (ages 6–14, coed), Girls Flag Football (ages 8–14), and competitive 7v7 (ages 12–17).

## Programs

- [NFL FLAG Football](https://missouriepic.com/nfl-flag): The official youth flag football program of the NFL, backed by all 32 NFL teams. No blocking or tackling. Fall League 2026 runs Tuesday nights, September 29 – November 3, at Ballparks of America.
- [Girls Flag Football](https://missouriepic.com/girls-flag-football): A dedicated girls-only competitive flag football league, ages 8–14.
- [7v7 Competitive Football](https://missouriepic.com/7v7): Tryout-based elite 7v7 competition for athletes ages 12–17.

- [About](https://missouriepic.com/about): Organization history, mission, and founder Terri Crisler.
